generationBrief: One standalone wide 16:9 event illustration per scene, no text or UI. Same late-thirties hero, charcoal jacket and black backpack; grey-haired neighbour around fifty in olive-grey jacket; same shaggy beige-grey mixed-breed dog with floppy ears. Ordinary Polish residential courtyard at night. Cool slate ambient palette, neutral skin, muted saturation, small warm window/lamp accents. Keep faces, clothing and dog readable. Opening: hero spots the pair 6–8m ahead before they notice him. Outcomes: divergent paths and wistful backward glance; walking past while the dog recognises him and tugs on its lead; crouching, ear scratching, a lick on the cheek and a brief unforced smile.
packaging: RGB WebP masters (quality 90) plus proportional 480/768/1024px WebP variants (quality 80). No palette or content post-processing. Loaded on demand through imageManifest.json; optimize-images.py discovers event masters automatically.
